rows.finding: The supplied full cases do more than contain a generic role. Masters define the qualifying Chan person through the label: one who cuts in a single stroke and who can knock off fetters in the black prison and act among hungry ghosts. This is an observable exhortative/verdict category with a corpus-specific deployment.
rows.requiredRepair: KEEP as a component meaning the decisive, fully capable person in a master’s challenge; anchor the interpretation in the two supplied demands and avoid defining it as masculinity.

rows.finding: The complete New Year formula is correctly kept, but ‘opening the new reign’ misreads the case. 元正 is New Year’s first day and 啟祚 opens auspicious fortune/blessing; the paired continuation is ‘all things are renewed.’ Nothing in either witness requires a change of reign.
rows.requiredRepair: Define it as ‘the New Year begins auspicious fortune/blessing,’ used as the recurrent answer/capping formula; preserve KEEP, unit, counts, and evidence.

rows.finding: Every supplied occurrence is the clipped tail of the declared parent 賊過後張弓, ‘drawing the bow after the thief has passed.’ Removing 賊 deletes the subject that makes the proverb intelligible; the exact count is substring inflation, not independent deployment.
rows.requiredRepair: REJECT as a clipped covered-parent candidate and retain the full proverb at 賊過後張弓.
